description: The immutable, append-only cross-entity governance log. Stock Version carries single-doc field diffs; an Audit Event carries a cross-entity governance action (an approval, an SoD/DoA block, an export decision) that is not one docfield change. No edit, no delete: a correction is a new compensating event.
